title: Crash when a ReflectionProbe first renders if Roughness Layers is set to 1
body:
- Related to https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/56747.

### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.3.stable (oldest version I can open godot-sponza on), 4.6.rc 76addfff1

### System information

Godot v4.6.rc (76addfff1) - Fedora Linux 43 (KDE Plasma Desktop Edition) on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 (nvidia; 580.119.02) - AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D 16-Core Processor (32 threads) - 62.33 GiB memory

### Issue description

Engine crashes when a ReflectionProbe first renders in a specific project:

The crash happens in both Forward+ and Mobile at the same location, but not Compatibility. The crash still happens if I remove all nodes *except* the Sponza node before adding the ReflectionProbe node.

This doesn't happen on a blank project with only a MeshInstance3D + BoxMesh and a ReflectionProbe.

**Edit:** The crash happens because of `reflections/sky_reflections/roughness_layers=1` in the Project Settings. Setting it to 2 or above works (default is 7).

### Steps to reproduce

- Import https://github.com/Calinou/godot-sponza.
- Open the 3D editor.
- Add a ReflectionProbe node as a child of the root node.
- It should now crash without doing anything else.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

https://github.com/Calinou/godot-sponza
